evidence: A user calls Iosevka their most-loved font for years and describes building a custom version.

evidence_sources.author: wartywhoa23
evidence_sources.excerpt: Iosevka, my absolutely most loved font for years! I've been using a custom version - you can customize the font¹ and build your own ttf (or better yet, ttc) using the build system supplied in the repository².

source_story_title: Iosevka is an open-source, sans-serif and slab-serif monospace font
